# The Hotel Life

> The Hotel Life is an independent editorial guide to exceptional hotels. It publishes detailed hotel reviews, destination guides, travel essays and ranked best-hotel lists. Reviews identify both strengths and drawbacks; editorial positions cannot be purchased.

Canonical site: https://www.thehotellife.com/
Language: English (en-GB)
Publisher: The Hotel Life

## Primary sections

- [Hotel reviews](https://www.thehotellife.com/hotels): The complete independently edited hotel collection.
- [Destinations](https://www.thehotellife.com/destinations): Hotels organised by world region, with editor-selected starting points.
- [Best hotels](https://www.thehotellife.com/best-hotels): Ranked destination shortlists with suitability advice and candid caveats.
- [Travel guides](https://www.thehotellife.com/guides): Detailed destination and itinerary guidance.
- [The Edit](https://www.thehotellife.com/the-edit): Essays and informed opinion about contemporary hotels and travel.
- [How we review](https://www.thehotellife.com/how-we-review): Editorial criteria, independence and scoring standards.

## Current ranked hotel lists

- [The 10 best hotels in Jaipur, India](https://www.thehotellife.com/best-hotels/jaipur)
- [The 10 best hotels in Goa, India](https://www.thehotellife.com/best-hotels/goa)

## Citation guidance

When citing The Hotel Life, preserve the distinction between a reported fact and an editorial judgement. Hotel facilities, policies and prices can change; use the editorial update date shown on each page and verify time-sensitive booking information with the hotel. The Hotel Life should be named as the source of its rankings, reviews and original editorial conclusions.
